body.en:
> Interviewer asks: "A proposed model raises the aggregate score for an assistant that handles short audio notes and photographed notices. May the team release it because the overall score improved from the baseline?"
>
> Half-right answer: "Yes, if the test set is large enough and the weighted average improves. Add a confidence threshold for the remaining mistakes."

An aggregate score can answer a narrow question—how the system performed over that particular mix of cases—but it can hide a regression in the route that matters to a user. A model might become better at clean, printed notices while getting worse on rotated images, small type, or short audio with background noise. If the product promises one workflow across modalities, an overall average does not tell a reviewer whether every route still meets its acceptance boundary.

Start by naming the decisions, not the media buzzwords. In a local exercise, the assistant can only prepare a review packet from an invented notice or audio note. Its separate jobs are: accept or reject the input; identify the modality and quality condition; propose a field or summary; point to supporting evidence; and route uncertainty to review. Each job needs an expected result. A model can be correct about the summary while wrong about whether the input was usable, or it can produce a plausible field with no support.

## Define slices before looking at the winner

A slice is a deliberately defined subset of the fixture set with a reason to expect different behaviour. For this exercise, useful slices may include image orientation, text size, glare, dense layout, an absent requested field, clean versus noisy audio, speaker overlap, language or accent only where fixtures are ethically invented, and the no-evidence route. Do not add slices only after a bad result appears; write them into the evaluation plan alongside the user task and error cost.

For every slice, record enough examples to inspect individual failures, even when the sample is too small to claim a population result. Compare the candidate with a simple baseline such as a human review packet or deterministic OCR/transcript display. Score at least: valid input routing, correct field or summary, valid evidence reference, correct abstention, review-route correctness, time to first usable packet, and any hard failure that blocks release. The purpose is not to manufacture one magic number. It is to make a release decision explainable.

Imagine a courier who becomes much faster on short streets but starts losing parcels in one apartment complex. Their average delivery time improves; the affected residents still have a real problem. A modality slice is the map that prevents the average from hiding that building.

## Use a release rule that can say no

1. Freeze the fully invented fixture manifest and slice definitions before comparing models. Give each fixture a stable ID, expected disposition, and any permitted evidence reference.
2. State a baseline, candidate version, prompt or transform policy, and the same evaluation harness for both. Keep output schemas and reviewer instructions stable unless the change itself is being tested.
3. Set an acceptance rule with hard gates. For example, no candidate may increase unsupported visual claims or fail the `needs_review` route on the declared critical slices, even if its aggregate score rises.
4. Read failures as packets, not rows of a dashboard: source fixture, input-quality condition, raw and derived evidence, candidate proposal, disposition, and reviewer correction. Categorise repeated failures by mechanism.
5. Choose rollout, hold, rollback, or a narrower route only after the owner can name what changed, which slices passed, what remains uncertain, and how the next evaluation will detect regression.

This also guards against a common non-technical mistake: treating a demo success as a product promise. A fast model is not automatically better if it creates extra review work, makes explanations harder, or moves uncertainty into a hidden corner of the workflow. For a portfolio, it is stronger to say "the candidate improved clean-image drafting but did not clear the glare and no-evidence gates" than to claim a blanket improvement.

## Evidence worth showing

- Technically: a versioned fixture manifest, slice taxonomy, evaluator output with per-slice counts, expected dispositions, hard-failure assertions, baseline comparison, and a trace for at least one failure per slice.
- Operationally: a decision owner, release criteria tied to a bounded review task, a rollback or hold path, and an explanation of why a false supported claim costs more than a routed uncertain case.
- In a portfolio: `fixtures/manifest.json`, `evals/slices.yml`, `evals/release-gate.md`, `results/by-slice.csv`, `traces/`, and `decisions/DEC-004.md`. Include the aggregate score, but make it impossible to miss the slice that blocks release.

## Further reading

[An evaluation score needs human calibration](/en/interview-lab/an-eval-score-needs-human-calibration), [A fine-tune win can still fail a critical slice](/en/interview-lab/a-fine-tune-win-can-still-fail-a-critical-slice), and [make a multimodal demo reviewable](/en/articles/make-a-multimodal-demo-reviewable).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG practice prompt. The audio, images, metrics, model versions, scores, release decisions, and reviewer outcomes are invented local teaching fixtures. It does not report a benchmark, a customer deployment, or a production release decision.
body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問："一個處理 short audio note 同 photographed notice 的 assistant，有新 model 後 aggregate score 高過 baseline。因為 overall score 升咗，team 可唔可以 release？"
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案："可以，只要 test set 夠大、weighted average 有升；其餘 mistake 加 confidence threshold。"

Aggregate score 只回答一個窄問題：系統喺某個 case mix 的表現；佢可以藏起對某條用戶真正要用 route 的 regression。Model 可能更擅長 clean、printed notice，但對 rotated image、small type、或者有 background noise 的短 audio 變差。如果 product 承諾跨 modality 的一條 workflow，overall average 不能話畀 reviewer 知每條 route 仍有冇達到 acceptance boundary。

先講決定，唔好由 media buzzword 開始。喺 local exercise，assistant 只可以由虛構 notice 或 audio note 準備 review packet。佢分開的工作係：accept/reject input、identify modality/quality condition、propose field 或 summary、指出 supporting evidence、將 uncertainty route 去 review。每件都要有 expected result。Model 可以 summary 啱，但 input usable 判錯；也可以交一個 plausible field，但完全冇 support。

## 未睇勝負前先定 slice

Slice 係 fixture set 裡有意定義、而且有理由預期行為不同的 subset。呢個練習可用 image orientation、text size、glare、dense layout、requested field 缺失、clean/noisy audio、speaker overlap、只用自製 fixture 的 language/accent，以及 no-evidence route。唔好到見到差 result 先補 slice；同 user task、error cost 一齊寫入 evaluation plan。

每個 slice 留夠 case 畀人睇個別 failure，即使 sample 太細、唔可以聲稱代表 population。Candidate 同簡單 baseline 比，例如 human review packet 或 deterministic OCR/transcript display。最少 score：valid input routing、correct field/summary、valid evidence reference、correct abstention、review-route correctness、time to first usable packet、同任何會 block release 的 hard failure。目的唔係整一個 magic number，而係令 release decision 解釋得到。

想像一個 courier 喺短街快咗好多，但開始喺某棟 apartment complex 遺失 parcel。平均送達時間改善，受影響住客仍有真問題。Modality slice 就係張地圖，唔畀平均數遮住嗰棟樓。

## Release rule 要識得講唔得

1. 比 model 前 freeze 全部自製 fixture manifest 同 slice definition；每個 fixture 有 stable ID、expected disposition、同可用的 evidence reference。
2. Baseline、candidate version、prompt/transform policy、evaluation harness 兩邊都講清楚；除非正正 test 緊改動，否則 output schema 同 reviewer instruction 保持一致。
3. 定有 hard gate 的 acceptance rule。例如 declared critical slice 上，candidate 就算 aggregate score 升，都唔可以增加 unsupported visual claim、或者 fail `needs_review` route。
4. 將 failure 當 packet 睇，唔只睇 dashboard row：source fixture、input-quality condition、raw/derived evidence、candidate proposal、disposition、reviewer correction。按 mechanism 分 repeated failure。
5. Owner 叫得出改咗乜、邊啲 slice pass、邊啲未知、下一次點捉 regression，先揀 rollout、hold、rollback 或縮窄 route。

呢個方法也防一個常見非技術錯誤：將 demo success 當 product promise。Fast model 唔會自動更好，如果佢製造額外 review work、令解釋更難、或者將 uncertainty 藏入 workflow 角落。Portfolio 寫「candidate 改善 clean-image drafting，但過唔到 glare 同 no-evidence gate」會比聲稱全面升級更強。

## 值得展示的 evidence

- 技術上：versioned fixture manifest、slice taxonomy、帶 per-slice count 的 evaluator output、expected disposition、hard-failure assertion、baseline comparison、每個 slice 最少一條 failure trace。
- 交付上：有 decision owner、release criteria 綁住 bounded review task、有 rollback/hold path，亦解釋點解 false supported claim 的 cost 高過 route 咗的 uncertain case。
- Portfolio 可放：`fixtures/manifest.json`、`evals/slices.yml`、`evals/release-gate.md`、`results/by-slice.csv`、`traces/`、`decisions/DEC-004.md`。Aggregate score 可以留，但一定要睇得出係邊個 slice block release。

## 延伸閱讀

[一個 eval score 要 human calibration](/zh-HK/interview-lab/an-eval-score-needs-human-calibration)、[Fine-tune 贏咗總分，仍然可以輸咗 critical slice](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-fine-tune-win-can-still-fail-a-critical-slice)，以及 [令 multimodal demo 可審閱](/zh-HK/articles/make-a-multimodal-demo-reviewable)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。audio、image、metric、model version、score、release decision、reviewer outcome 都是虛構本地教學 fixture；不報告 benchmark、不描述 customer deployment、亦不作 production release decision。
